keyword.en: concrete pump dimensions metres or millimetres
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵外形尺寸是米还是毫米

title.en: How Dimension Units Differ on Pump Sheets
title.zh: 泵的外形尺寸单位为什么不一样

description.en: Most Xingtai concrete pumps print length, width and height in millimetres. LZ-60 and LZ-80 print metres.
description.zh: 多数邢台混凝土泵以外形的毫米数印长宽高。LZ-60 和 LZ-80 印的是米。

h1.en: How Dimension Units Differ on Pump Sheets
h1.zh: 泵的外形尺寸单位为什么不一样

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints outline dimensions on its Xingtai concrete pumps, but the unit is not always millimetres. Electric 20 prints 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. B500S-83D prints 915 × 550 × 550 mm. LZ-60 and LZ-80 print 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Reading 6.6 as millimetres would shrink the machine a thousandfold. Read the unit printed at the end of the cell.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵上印了外形尺寸，但单位不总是毫米。电动20为 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm。B500S-83D 为 915 × 550 × 550 mm。LZ-60 和 LZ-80 为 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。把 6.6 读成毫米，会把机器缩小一千倍。请读格子末尾印出的单位。

body.en: Trailer and compact pages such as Electric 15 (1900 × 900 × 1200 mm), Diesel 120 (7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm) and the integrated mixer (3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm) state mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery is stating the printed outline, not a site layout drawing.
body.zh: 拖泵和紧凑页，例如电动15（1900 × 900 × 1200 mm）、柴油120（7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm）和搅拌泵一体机（3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm），写的是 mm。河北品锦机械给出的是印出的外形，不是现场布置图。

body.en: LZ-60 and LZ-80 both print 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. The same dimensions do not make the pumps the same. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h and a 300 m height. LZ-80 prints two output ceilings and a height cell that says consult factory standard.
body.zh: LZ-60 和 LZ-80 都印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。尺寸相同不等于两台泵相同。LZ-60 印 50 m³/h 和 300 m 高度。LZ-80 印两档产量上限，高度格写的是咨询工厂标准。

body.en: The label is L×W×H, length, width and height. Do not reorder them. A 915 mm length on B500S-83D is the first number, not the height.
body.zh: 标题是长×宽×高。不要重排。B500S-83D 的 915 mm 是第一个数，即长度，不是高度。

question.en: Which pumps print dimensions in metres?

answer.en: LZ-60 and LZ-80. Both print 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m.

question.en: Is 6.6 m the same as 6.6 mm?
question.zh: 6.6 m 和 6.6 mm 一样吗？

answer.en: No. The cell says m. Other pumps that intend millimetres print mm.
answer.zh: 不一样。这一格写的是 m。打算用毫米的其他泵会印 mm。

question.en: Does the same metre outline mean the same pump?
question.zh: 相同的米制外形就是同一台泵吗？

answer.en: No. LZ-60 and LZ-80 share the dimension line and differ on output, engine and height.
answer.zh: 不是。LZ-60 和 LZ-80 外形行相同，产量、发动机和高度不同。

answer.en: Length, width and height, in that order, as printed by Hebei Pinjin Machinery.
answer.zh: 按河北品锦机械印出的顺序：长、宽、高。
